sentences.text: Annelies Marie `` Anne '' Frank -LRB- -LSB- ʔanəliːs maˈʁiː ˈʔanə ˈfʁaŋk -RSB- ; -LSB- ʔɑnəˈlis maˈri ˈʔɑnə ˈfrɑŋk -RSB- ; 12 June 1929 -- February or March 1945 -RRB- was a German-born diarist .

One of the most discussed Jewish victims of the Holocaust , she gained fame posthumously following the publication of The Diary of a Young Girl -LRB- originally Het Achterhuis ; The Secret Annex -RRB- , in which she documents her life in hiding from 1942 to 1944 , during the German occupation of the Netherlands in World War II .	the Holocaust	the Holocaust	The Diary of a Young Girl	The Diary of a Young Girl	German occupation of the Netherlands	German occupation of the Netherlands	World War II	World War II
It is one of the world 's most widely known books and has been the basis for several plays and films .

Born in Frankfurt , Germany , she lived most of her life in or near Amsterdam , Netherlands , having moved there with her family at the age of four-and-a-half when the Nazis gained control over Germany .	Frankfurt	Frankfurt
Born a German national , Frank lost her citizenship in 1941 and thus became stateless .	stateless	statelessness
By May 1940 , the Franks were trapped in Amsterdam by the German occupation of the Netherlands .	German occupation of the Netherlands	German occupation of the Netherlands

As persecutions of the Jewish population increased in July 1942 , the family went into hiding in some concealed rooms behind a bookcase in the building where Anne 's father worked .	persecutions of the Jewish population	History of the Jews during World War II	concealed rooms	Anne Frank House
From then until the family 's arrest by the Gestapo in August 1944 , Anne kept a diary she had received as a birthday present , and wrote in it regularly .	Gestapo	Gestapo
Following their arrest , the Franks were transported to concentration camps .	concentration camps	Nazi concentration camps

In October or November 1944 , Anne and her sister , Margot , were transferred to Bergen-Belsen concentration camp from Auschwitz , where they died -LRB- probably of typhus -RRB- a few months later .	Bergen-Belsen concentration camp	Bergen-Belsen concentration camp	Margot	Margot Frank	Auschwitz	Auschwitz concentration camp	typhus	typhus

They were originally estimated by the Red Cross to have died in March , with Dutch authorities setting 31 March as their official date of death , but research by the Anne Frank House in 2015 suggests they more likely died in February .	Red Cross	International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement

Frank 's father , Otto , the only survivor of the family , returned to Amsterdam after the war to find that her diary had been saved by one of the helpers , Miep Gies , and his efforts led to its publication in 1947 .	Otto	Otto Frank	Miep Gies	Miep Gies

It was translated from its original Dutch version and first published in English in 1952 as The Diary of a Young Girl , and has since been translated into over 60 languages .	The Diary of a Young Girl	The Diary of a Young Girl
